card.name: Frequency words like every and monthly
card.fires_on: The time unit that completes a recurring-frequency phrase, such as year, day or week after every/each, or monthly/weekly after at or on a. Mostly in monitoring and dosing schedules.

modes.label: Every + time unit
modes.description: A unit of time such as day, week or year right after every, each or every single.
modes.example: Administer Fexinidazole Tablets once daily with food each<< day>> at about the same time of the day

modes.label: Monthly/weekly intervals
modes.description: An adverb like monthly or weekly after at or on a, before intervals or basis.
modes.example: assess fasting serum phosphorus on a<< monthly>> basis, measured 2 weeks post-d

card.writes: It promotes words like thereafter and basis and suppresses words for daily, monthly and annually, so the frequency is not stated a second time.
card.plain: It marks the point where a phrase like 'every week' or 'at monthly intervals' is complete.
